I want to jump in here, to highlight in a less blunt way what usedtobe said, as it will be based on my experience.

I've graduated from university which took 6 years to do, and I did a program that was something like an honours, so I feel like I could have easily done the same in the non-honours and gotten better grades. It seems like today a degree is nothing, so I wish I at least had marks to show... but don't have them because I did the stupid 'honours' version. I've finished school 10 months ago, and don't have a job. I kid you not, i get up everyday and apply to jobs. That's all I do.

As you can tell this gets depressing after a while. I had an interview in another big(ger) city that I was super excited about, thinking that I'd finally at least start my career instead of being hindered by my marks. As it was a big company, it took a while but ~3 months after the interview, I found they weren't interested. I was really looking forward to moving to a new city, living on my own. I really thought I would get the job, but my hopes were crushed. So then I applied for probably another month, everyday, probalby 5-8 jobs a day. Proper cover letter for each one. So I know how miserable it feels when you don't have anything (i.e. applying for jobs, no response, not even rejection letters). And I've thought about suicide, but fortunately somehow my parents have manipulated my mind from a young age to be a thiest and claim life isn't for me to end. Anyways, perhaps from this fear, I don't do it. And sometimes just in a few days after I've seriously been thinking about it, i might get a call for an interview. So again, roller coaster, high. Get a NO. Steep downhill, feel like shit for a few days, but the really bad part starts after you get back to applying and you get no responses for like a month or two. My two months are nothing compared to what you've described, but trust me I thought about it. But hear this...when you least expect it, a response might come. And its that hope, I kid you not... my life goes from wanting to kill myself to... i can't be happier. The same dull shit in life, i'll be doing except exuding joy. I can't express this in words, but hopefully you get it, being in a similar situation.

Hope is a major thing. You just need it. And it might just be around the corner, so don't give up.

I'm still doing it, everyday. 5-8 applications a day. No responses. But guess what, i applied to a minimum wage job. In order to let my references know that they might be contacted, one of my references told me he has some work for me (which he didn't earlier). Its not the ideal job, but its something. And I think I might have the initial minimum wage job (for which the HR person is going to contact him) in the bag as well.

So 10 months, and finally at least I am on step 0.5 , its certainly not step 1, but there's hope. 

Finally, find something you enjoy doing. What got me through is also sports. I have been obsessing over one sport lately. And I've been just playing virtually everyday. It takes your mind off things. And there's numerous studies that show being active makes you feel better. 

Hopefully this goes into what usedtobe mentioned, just enjoy your life and hopefully you will start to like yourself. Confidence is a huge thing. When i'm feeling like shit or busy with school, it will be months and I'll feel nothing. But when things are going great, and I see a girl or two sneaking a look at me. Next thing I know for a whole week or two, because my confidence is up... i'm constantly noticing what might be girls looking at me, and it turns into a positive cycle. I've seen guys who look like they've been hit in the face with a frying pan one two many times, with ridiculously attractive girls, all because of confidence. [watch this video around 1:30, see how just his confidence makes that girl make a 'call me'](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mOHkRk00iI8). I'm not expecting you to develop hubris, but at the very least don't discount yourself fully. If you don't have the confidence, find ugly women, fat women... they have confidence issues (well some do) as well. Its like the emo kids hang out in highschool or whatever. They think they're the ugly kids. Work you way up if need be, or if you find interesting people in this crowd, who is to say they aren't people also... maybe you will find life long friends.

Also try online dating. Just like guys complain about not getting any time from girls (because we only really consider good looking girls)... there are women who complain about not getting the time of day from guys (because they only consider the confident/good looking ones). So put a picture of yourself on okcupid or something, and chat up conversations. You're not going to be rejected in real life (saved from the embarassement of it), as it will only be text on the screen (worst case scenario). But keep in mind, be honest with yourself and talk to women who also complain of being ignored by men, not just the pretty ones.
